profile.headline: Software Engineer at UCAR (University Corporation for Atmospheric Research).
profile.summary: Software engineering, Sr. DevOps Developer/Linux Admin, Systems Engineer, Systems Administrator; UNIX including Redhat Linux, Debian, HP-UX, and AIX; scripting with bash and ksh, Perl, Python, C language, and Windows PowerShell; Windows Server 2008, Windows Server 2012; HP ProLiant Servers, HP RP 9000 and HP RS IA Servers; IBM RS and p-Servers; SAN Storage, including HP EVA 5000 and 8100, NetApp, and EMC ClARiiON; UNIX services including NFS/NIS/DNS/NTP; Backups and Restores using Symantec NetBackup; Virtualization, including VMware and Hyper-V; Developer, Systems Engineering and Administration; automation; data center management and migrations; configuration management.

company.name: UCAR - The University Corporation for Atmospheric Research

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: Supporting the HP Enterprise Software Lab within Hewlett-Packard, including all servers running Linux, Windows, HP-UX, and AIX, racking new servers, managing ESXi hosts, virtual machines using VMware vSphere, virtual data centers, setting up and supporting HP EVA and HP 3Par storage arrays, and scripting and automating sysadmin duties where possible, and troubleshooting server issues and resolving.

positions.title: Sr. DevOps Developer
positions.description: Currently working as a member of the RelayHealth development and operations team to develop automation tools to deliver solutions for healthcare providers and patients.

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description: Managing and supporting large compute farm for HP's software development lab as part of HP's corporate IT, including scripting and automation, Debian and Redhat Linux, HP-UX, Solaris, Windows; scripting admin tasks and automation; developing monitors for servers and services they provided; developed scripts for configuration management and user access control.

positions.title: Systems Admin
positions.description:
IT support of HP's manufacturing operations.
Developed process applications for data tracking and analysis.
Developed tools for automating manufacturing processes.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Information Systems and Marketing, Dual Major
